items.title_en: Woman Captures Rare Rainbow Clouds In Ladakh, Internet Wonders If Pics Are AI
items.title_zh: 女子在拉达克捕捉到罕见的彩虹云，互联网怀疑照片是否是人工智能
items.summary_en: A woman driving through Ladakh captured rare rainbow-coloured clouds glowing in pink, green, blue and violet, leaving many viewers wondering if the pictures were real.
items.summary_zh: 一名驾车穿过拉达克的女子捕捉到了罕见的彩虹色云彩，闪烁着粉色、绿色、蓝色和紫色的光芒，让许多观众怀疑这些照片是否真实。
